The same file resolved NPIs for all 6 roster members who had none (full-forename + specialty + employer lock; Robert O'Connor 1710103270 GENERAL SURGERY/Charlotte rejected, 1952347643 ANESTHESIOLOGY/McLeod accepted). Healthgrades is CHECKED-AND-ABSENT rather than unpublishable, proved by control: its education schema uses typeCodes MEDSCH/INTERN/RESIDE/FELLOW and a control provider from the same Georgetown result set (dr-edward-gologorsky-2fywb) returns a 1994 UPMC FELLOW row, so the field exists and is simply empty for all 12; 3 of the 6 have education:[] entirely.
